Class ProgressBar

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.ProgressBar
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class ProgressBar extends AbstractPanelElement
A bar filled to a fraction, read every frame: health, progress, a timer. No input. 
ProgressBar.builder().size(80, 6).value(() -> boat.health() / 40.0)
        .fillColor(0xFFC08040).label(() -> Component.literal("Hull")).build();

value is read-only: the bar shows a fraction (clamped to 0..1) and never writes one, so it takes no state. It fills in any of four directions; an optional label is centred on it. Caps to its panel's width.
